hypothesis: Test whether DIN-style candidate-conditioned history attention can convert the hundreds of train-period user interactions into a sharper within-user relevance signal than global recency pooling, while keeping the strongest stable DeepFM recipe otherwise fixed. For short-video ranking, not all past positives are equally relevant to a candidate impression; weighting history items by similarity to the current item should help top-5 ordering and may also slightly improve GAUC.
